ddcui.description: ddcui command-line options configuration block. Only set fields needed to override defaults or enable features. All keys are optional unless noted otherwise.

ddcui.all_capabilities.description: Always include features found in the capabilities string. Applies when feature_set is MCCS.

ddcui.custom_features.description: List of feature codes (hex strings) for CUSTOM feature set. Codes: 2-char hex, optionally prefixed with 'x' or suffixed with 'h'. E.g. '10', 'x12', '14h'. Ignored unless feature_set is CUSTOM.

ddcui.ddc_errors_to_terminal.description: Report DDC protocol and data errors to the terminal.

ddcui.feature_set.description: Initial feature set to show. Valid values: MCCS, MANUFACTURER, COLOR, CUSTOM

ddcui.model.description: Model name as specified in the monitor's EDID and shown on the toolbar.

ddcui.nc_values_source.description: Source of values shown in the drop-down for Non-Continuous features. Valid: MCCS, CAPABILITIES, BOTH

ddcui.only_capabilities.description: Restrict features to those in the capabilities string. Applies when feature_set is MCCS, COLOR, or MANUFACTURER.

ddcui.show_unsupported.description: Display unsupported features in the feature set.

ddcui.style.description: Qt style name (e.g., 'Fusion', 'Windows'). List styles via --styles.

ddcui.thread_id.description: Prefix trace messages with thread id.

ddcui.trace_files.description: List of filenames (simple-file-name) to trace. May be specified more than once.

ddcui.trace_functions.description: List of function names to trace. May be specified more than once.

ddcui.trace_groups.description: List of trace group names to trace. May be specified more than once.

ddcui.use_latest_nc_values.description: Always use values from latest MCCS version.
